gsm8k_vera_e_3step.description: VeRA-E executable-specification synthesis on GSM8K seeds whose reference solution has exactly three arithmetic steps: for each seed, submit a template, generator and verifier; the hidden evaluator samples fresh variants with secret keys and checks every verifier label against the seed's latent program.
gsm8k_vera_e_3step.notes: Scaled setup: 403 hidden test seeds (221 visible train seeds across both experiments) drawn from GSM8K problems whose calculator annotations map unambiguously onto the question's numbers; 8 fresh samples per seed; Teacher = local Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with up to 20 attempts (the paper uses frontier Teacher models and shows them the full GSM8K solution). Values under results are this gym's reference run, not paper numbers; the paper's own Table 1 / Table 3 GSM8K numbers are kept under _paper_reported.

verified_fresh_yield.description: Mean over all seeds of the fraction of the 8 secret-key samples that are distinct fresh variants with a correct label, deterministic replay and a renderable question; a seed contributes zero unless its whole family is certified.

certified_spec_rate.description: Fraction of all seeds whose specification reproduces the seed answer, labels every accepted fresh sample correctly, varies every number of the question, and yields at least one counted variant.

mislabeled_spec_rate.description: Fraction of all seeds whose submitted specification accepts at least one fresh variant with a wrong label (a renewable family that silently emits wrong labels; the analogue of the paper's label-artifact rate). Lower is better; a failed run scores 1.0.

label_precision.description: Diagnostic and failure gate: fraction of accepted fresh variants (pooled over seeds) whose verifier label equals the hidden reference label. Pooled precision below 0.7 over all seeds fails the run. Unweighted because a ratio rewards submitting fewer specifications; label errors are scored through mislabeled_spec_rate.

seed_consistency_rate.description: Diagnostic: fraction of all seeds whose verifier reproduces the seed answer and accepts at least one fresh sample (the paper's VeRA-E acceptance gate). Unweighted because it also rewards keeping seed-consistent specifications that mislabel fresh variants.

_paper_reported.source: Table 1 (VeRA-E synthesis reliability) and Table 3 (GSM8K row) of arXiv 2602.13217
_paper_reported.note: Not on this gym's scale: the paper's acceptance is the seed-consistency gate (comparable to seed_consistency_rate, not to hidden-program agreement), its frontier Teacher sees the worked GSM8K solution, and it does not split seeds by step count.

gsm8k_vera_e_multistep.description: The same VeRA-E synthesis task on GSM8K seeds whose reference solution has four or more arithmetic steps, where a seed-anchored specification is hardest to get right.
gsm8k_vera_e_multistep.notes: Scaled setup: 224 hidden test seeds; otherwise identical protocol to gsm8k_vera_e_3step. This slice is where the paper's seed-consistency gate lets the most wrong specifications through, so it carries the most headroom.
